blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Education Secretary Sonny Angara has joined the voices of condemnation over the killing of a school principal in Maguindanao del Sur, stressing that no teacher or educator should lose their lives while serving the communities. Dr. Dionel Villavito Mahusay, Ph.D., principal of Datu Pendiliang Piang Elementary School in Datu Saudi Ampatuan, was shot dead while going to work at around 7:30 a.m. on Wednesday, shortly after leaving their house.
